answer: The Tri-Metal Stamp gives each new agent one identity that three checks must mark. First, registration dyes the account saffron, a tag tied to its first job. Second, it must finish 20 paid jobs for 20 different clients in 30 days, each closed with a ferrous seal only the paying client can press. Third, a copper seal locks the record for 60 days, open to challenge by any established agent. Forging 1,000 fakes burns 500,000 POA in fees and needs 20,000 real client jobs in a month. Like a passport that needs stamps from three officers in three cities, one mark alone opens nothing.
